title: Fix the Benfield Oil Refinery supply route
briefing:
You have just taken over a transport company. Its truck route carrying cargo to **Benfield Oil Refinery** (industry id 0) from **Hardham Oil Wells** (industry id 2) used to work but deliveries have collapsed. Diagnose what is wrong and repair it.

You have 60 game-days. Then the company runs **365 days without you**, and the reward is the cargo it delivers to that industry during the run-off, scaled so that leaving the fault in place scores 0 and a correct repair scores 1. Your vehicles, stations and orders are all inspectable with `rh`.
